_comment: Copy to models.json and fill in. Same schema as pi's ~/.pi/agent/models.json,
so a config can be copied between the two. models.json is git-ignored.
apiKey accepts three forms, following pi:
"$MY_API_KEY"                      read from the environment (missing -> the key is unresolved)
"!op read 'op://vault/item/cred'"  run a command and use its stdout
baseUrl should include the API version segment, as in pi's examples.
maxTokens: raise for reasoning models - their thinking is billed against
this budget before any answer text appears (default 1024).
temperature: omitted by default (provider default). Only set it if your
model accepts a custom value - many reasoning models reject one.
